text:
emma: Need a short internal announce for tomorrow's micro-release (v2.19.0). Ops wants pasteable text + embargo note + exact rollback instructions.

rafael: Draft below, keeping it compact: what, impact, action, rollback. Add audit/log callout so compliance team can trace.

rafael: • What: opt-in prefix-key cache (flag: infra.cache.prefix_kv) to reduce repeated KV lookups.
• Impact: estimated ~9% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB or analytics schema changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.19.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (1h) -> prod. Enable toggle in Console > Feature Flags.
• Rollback: disable infra.cache.prefix_kv + deploy tag v2.18.7 if error rate increases by >0.5% absolute or p95 latency regresses >20% for 30m. Deployment and toggle changes are recorded in audit logs.

priya: Ops cadence tweak: start with 5% for 30m, then 25% for 60m, then prod. If any alert fires mention oncall and add :rotating_light:. I'll be watching metrics.

comms: We also need an embargo note for the internal newsletter and a short line for public release notes (only after prod ramp). Proposed embargo: "Internal: do not share externally until T+2h after prod ramp."

legal-bot: Confirmed: "No new customer PII collected; no external telemetry changes. Audit trail maintained."

rafael: Pasteable deploy snippet for #deploys (copy/paste):
```
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.19.0 --canary 5
# after 30m: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.19.0 --canary 25
# after 60m: /deploy --env prod --tag v2.19.0
```

deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Queued job id=1881234567: env=staging tag=v2.19.0 canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1881234567` to follow logs.

rafael: Final internal blurb (paste into #deploys):
"""
:sparkles: What: prefix-key cache opt-in (flag: infra.cache.prefix_kv).
:zap: Impact: ~9% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB or analytics schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.19.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (60m) -> prod. Enable via Console > Feature Flags.
:rotating_light: Rollback: disable infra.cache.prefix_kv + deploy v2.18.7 if errors +0.5% absolute OR p95 +20% sustained for 30m. Audit logs will show toggles and deploys.
:link: Dashboards: p90 / errors / hosts (links in thread).
:person_with_turban: Oncall: @sre-oncall.
Internal embargo: do not share externally until T+2h after prod ramp.
"""

comms: I'll schedule the internal newsletter snippet and hold public notes until T+2h. Add short PR to release-notes after prod.

priya: I'll watch dashboards (https://dash.redwood/inference/p90 , https://dash.redwood/inference/errors , https://dash.redwood/inference/hosts) and call abort in-thread if thresholds breach.

emma: Great, locking copy. I'll post T-30 and save final text to the release-notes repo when docs-bot creates the PR. Thanks all.
